text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Kawalan
Harga dan Antipencatutan (Mekanisme untuk Menentukan Keuntung an Tinggi
yang Tidak Munasabah) (Margin Keuntungan Bersih) 2014.

Mekanisme untuk menentukan keuntungan tinggi yang tidak munasabah

2. (1) Mekanisme untuk menentukan keuntungan tinggi yang tidak munasabah
bagi tempoh dari 2 Januari 2015 hingga 31 Mac 2015 dan 1 April 2015 hingga
30 Jun 2016 adalah bahawa tidak boleh ada kenaikan dalam margin keuntungan bersih
bagi apa-apa barangan atau perkhidmatan.

(2) Tiada kenaikan dalam margin keuntungan bersih bagi apa-apa barangan
atau perkhidmatan yang disebut dalam subperaturan (1)—

(a) dalam tempoh dari 2 Januari 2015 hingga 31 Mac 2015 jika
formula dalam perenggan 2 Bahagian II Jadual dipenuhi; dan

(b) dalam tempoh dari 1 April 2015 hingga 30 Jun 2016 jika fo rmula
dalam perenggan 3 atau 4 Bahagian III Jadual dipenuhi.

JADUAL

[Subperaturan 2(2)]

FORMULA UNTUK MENENTUKAN BAHAWA TIADA KENAIKAN DALAM MARGIN
KEUNTUNGAN BERSIH

BAHAGIAN I

PERMULAAN

Tafsiran
1. (1) Bagi maksud Jadual ini—

"caj pengenalan" ertinya  caj pengenalan bagi apa-apa perkhidmatan baru yang
dibekalkan atau ditawarkan untuk dibekalkan;

"caj promosi" ertinya caj bagi perkhidmatan yang ditunjukkan mengikut  apa-apa
cara sebagai kurang daripada caj yang perkhidmatan itu, atau perkhidmatan yang sama
perihalan, dibekalkan atau ditawarkan untuk dibekalkan sebelum itu;

"cukai input" mempunyai erti yang  diberikan kepadanya di bawah seksyen 2
Akta Cukai Barang dan Perkhidmatan 2014 [Akta 762];

"cukai output" mempunyai erti yang  diberikan kepadanya di bawah seksyen 2
Akta Cukai Barang dan Perkhidmatan 2014;

"harga jualan murah" ertinya harga barangan yang ditunjukkan mengikut
apa-apa cara sebagai  kurang daripada harga  yang barangan itu, atau barangan yang
sama perihalan, dijual atau ditawarkan untuk dijual sebelum itu;

 "harga kos" ertinya harga yang dibayar bagi pemerolehan barangan, atau harga
yang di bayar bagi pemerolehan apa -apa barangan atau perkhidmatan  lain bagi
membekalkan perkhidmatan, dan kos operasi yang berhubung dengan pengeluaran dan
penjualan barangan atau pembekalan perkhidmatan;

"harga pengenalan" ertinya harga pengenalan bagi apa-apa barangan baru yang
dijual atau ditawarkan untuk dijual;

"orang kena cukai" mempunyai erti yang  diberikan kepadanya di bawah
seksyen 2 Akta Cukai Barang dan Perkhidmatan 2014.

 (2) Apa-apa ungkapan atau petunjuk, sama  ada secara langsung atau t idak
langsung, dengan apa jua cara pun yang digunakan atau diberikan dalam penjalanan
perdagangan atau perniagaan, yang menunjukkan atau berkemungkinan difahami
sebagai menunjukkan bahawa—

(a) harga yang barangan itu ditawarkan adalah kurang daripada harga
yang barangan itu , atau barangan yang sama perihalan,  dijual atau
ditawarkan untuk dijual sebelum itu; atau

(b) caj yang perkhidmatan itu ditawarkan adalah kurang daripada caj
yang perkhidmatan itu , atau perkhidmatan yang sama perihalan,
dibekalkan atau ditawarkan untuk dibekalkan sebelum itu,

hendaklah dikira sebagai suatu petunjuk bahawa orang yang menggunakan ungkapan
itu atau memberikan petunjuk itu menjual atau menawar kan untuk menjual atau
membekalkan atau menawar kan untuk membekalkan barangan atau perkhidmatan itu
dengan harga jualan murah atau caj promosi, mengikut mana-mana yang berkenaan.

(3) Ungkapan yang disebut  dalam subperenggan (2) termasuk ungkapan
"jualan", "diskaun", " pengurangan", " belian terbaik ", "harga ter baik", "caj terbaik ",
"harga istimewa", "caj istimewa", "harga runtuh", " harga lebih murah setiap hari " atau
"tawaran separuh harga".

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING ACT 2011

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING (MECHANISM TO DETERMINE
UNREASONABLY HIGH PROFIT) (NET PROFIT MARGIN) REGULATIONS 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 15 of the Price Control and
Anti-Profiteering Act 2011 [Act 723], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation
1. These regulations may be cited as the Price Control and Anti -Profiteering
(Mechanism to Determine Unreasonably High Profit)  (Net Profit Margin)
Regulations 2014.

Mechanism to determine unreasonably high profit
2. (1)  The mechanism to determine that profit is unreasonably high for the
period from 2 January 2015 to 31 March 2015 and 1 April 2015 to 30 June 2016 is that
there shall be no increment in the net profit margin of any goods or services.

(2)  There is no increment in the net profit margin of any goods or services
referred to in subregulation (1)—

(a) within the period from 2 January 2015 to 31 March 2015 if the
formula in paragraph 2 of Part II of the Schedule is satisfied; and

(b) within the period from 1 April 2015 to 30 June 2016 if the formula
in paragraph 3 or 4 of Part III of the Schedule is satisfied.

SCHEDULE

FORMULA TO DETERMINE THAT NO INCREMENT IN THE NET PROFIT MARGIN

PART I

PRELIMINARY

Interpretation
1. (1) For the purposes of this Schedule—

"introductory charge" means the introductory charge for any new services
supplied or offered for supply;

"promotional charge" means the charge for services which is indicated in any
manner to be less than the charge at which the services, or services of the same
description, were previously supplied or offered for supply;

"input tax" has the meaning assigned to it unde r section 2 of the Goods and
Services Tax Act 2014 [Act 762];

"output tax" has the meaning assigned to it under section 2 of the Goods and
Services Tax Act 2014;

 "cheap sale price" means the price of goods which is indicated in any manner to
be less than the price at which the goods, or goods of the same description, were
previously sold or offered for sale;

"cost price" means the price paid on the acquisition of goods, or the price paid on
the acquisition of any other goods or services for the supply of services,  and the
operating cost in relation to the production and sale of goods or the supply of services;

 "introductory price" means the introductory price for any  new goods sold or
offered for sale;

"taxable person" has the meaning assigned to it under section 2 of the Goods and
Services Tax Act 2014.

(2) Any expression or indication, whether direct or indirect, by whatever
means used or given in the course of t rade or business, indicating or likely to be
understood as indicating that—

(a) the price at which the goods are offered is less than the price at
which the goods, or goods of the same description, were
previously sold or offered for sale; or

(b) the charge at which the services are offered is less than the charge
at which the services, or services of the same description, were
previously supplied or offered for supply,

shall be treated as an indication that the person using the expression or giving such
indication is selling or offering to sell or supplying or offering to supply the goods or
services at cheap sale price or promotional charge, as the case may be.

(3) The expression referred to in subparagraph (2) includes the expression of
"sale", "discount", "reduction", "best buy", "best price", "best charge", "special price",
"special charge", "price crush", "cheaper price everyday" or "offer half price".

  (h) in relation to paragraph (h) of SP 0, is the

 SP0 (a)      is the selling price of goods or the charge

  (b) is the selling price of goods sold or

  (c) is the charge for  services supplied or

  (d) is the  normal selling  price of new goods

  (e) is the normal charge for new services

  (f) is the selling price of goods or the charge

  (g) is the selling price of goods sold or

(h) is the selling price of goods sold or
offered for sale or the charge for services

supplied or offered for supply on the first

1 January 2015;

 COG0 is the price paid on the acquisition of the goods,
or the price paid on the acquisition of any other

referred to in SP0;

 OC0 is the operating cost in relation to the production
and sale of the goods, or the supply of the

 X3 is the net profit margin of goods or services in
Ringgit Malaysia on the date the goods or

 SP3 is the  selling price of goods sold or offered for

 COG3 is the price paid on the acquisition of the goods,

 OC3 is the operating cost in relation to the production
